Let me start by exploring the codebase to understand the structure and find the relevant files.Now I can see the bugs clearly. Let me run the tests first to confirm failures:I can see all 6 bugs. Let me fix them:

**`priceCart.js` bugs:**
1. Crashes when `coupon` is `null` — tries to access `coupon.code` unconditionally
2. Doesn't handle items with `price` field (only `unitPrice`)
3. `mergeCartItems` uses first item's price instead of the newest (last) item's price

**`reserveInventory.js` bugs:**
1. `reserveBatch` always calls `catalog.products.find(...)` — crashes when catalog is a plain array
2. When product isn't found, passes `undefined` to `reserveInventory` which crashes instead of returning `{ ok: false, reserved: 0 }`All 7 tests pass. Here's a summary of the fixes:

**`src/checkout/priceCart.js`** — 3 bugs:
- `priceCart` crashed when `coupon` was `null` — added optional chaining (`cart.coupon?.code?.length`)
- Items with a `price` field (catalog products) were priced as `NaN` — added `?? item.price` fallback in the reduce
- `mergeCartItems` kept the *first* item's price instead of the newest — rewrote the merge to update `unitPrice` when an existing entry is found

**`src/fulfillment/reserveInventory.js`** — 2 bugs:
- `reserveBatch` always accessed `catalog.products` — added a check so it also accepts a plain array (`Array.isArray(catalog) ? catalog : catalog.products`)
- When a SKU wasn't found in the catalog, `undefined` was passed to `reserveInventory` causing a crash — added a `!product` guard that returns `{ ok: false, remaining: 0, reserved: 0 }`
